prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1166; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of the collision is consistent with the type and force of the soft tissue injury described. Over the course of 17 visits, care included manual therapy, guided stretching, and a graduated home exercise program. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved. Nearly all reported findings are based on the patient's own descriptions of pain and limited motion. Lumbar imaging and orthopedic examination tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same area of the back is known to this office. Two similar billing entries for the same date of service are currently under routine review. Prognosis is good, with anticipated full recovery and discharge from active care once the home program is maintained.
